title: ARIA - Live Polite
product-requirement: Screen readers should read out a change to an element with the aria-live attribute as "polite"
specification: When enabled, the screen reader SHOULD use the semantic document structure and ARIA markup
assertion: Test passes if the screen reader reads out the new inner html of a focused div element with aria-live="polite"
